preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 1 and 80000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects nodes with numbers between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: No edge connects a node to itself.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(all(node not in path_ab and node not in path_cd for node in range(1, n + 1)) for a in range(1, n) for b in range(a + 1, n + 1) for c in range(1, n) for d in range(c + 1, n + 1) if a != c and a != d and b != c and b != d)
postconditions.description: The output is the number of pairs of paths (a, b) and (c, d) that do not share any common nodes.
